caption: The drawing depicts a stoneware vessel with a rounded body, narrow neck, and slightly flared rim, set within a rectangular border on a neutral background. The vessel is predominantly gray-beige in color, with blue accents. Two small handles, one on each side near the upper shoulder, are attached with blue glaze at the base. The front of the vessel features blue lettering that reads "CLARK & FOX / ATHENS NY," above the large numbers "1837," also in blue, with a blue wavy line beneath. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is an inset close-up that shows a handle in greater detail, focusing on the blue-glazed attachment points. The drawing is signed "Yolande DeLasser" in the bottom right corner outside the main border.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
